capabilityPolicy.interaction: Automation when stdin or stderr is not a terminal or CI is set; otherwise Rich Interactive for recognized TERM values and Plain Interactive for other terminals.
capabilityPolicy.stdout: Command Result only; redirection disables color but does not move diagnostics.
capabilityPolicy.stderr: Rich Live View or Plain prompts/diagnostics; diagnostics are lease-aware during Rich rendering.
capabilityPolicy.automation: Never reads stdin, emits no prompt/notice/phase controls, and preserves command-specific noninteractive behavior.
capabilityPolicy.color: NO_COLOR and non-TTY streams produce control-free output.

entries.stdin: none except the private thumbnail-worker framed protocol
entries.stdout: discovery/help document or exact version; completion emits the raw shell script; no output for parser errors
entries.stderr: one safe actionable error line for parser/command failures; optional redacted panic stack when DEBUG/development is enabled
entries.exit: help/version/completion 0; no-argument discovery and parser/ordinary command errors 1; owned exit-coded child/result status is propagated
entries.signals: root installs the process signal context; no root-owned foreground service
entries.sideEffects: help/version/completion bypass diagnostics and command effects; startup transaction may publish a prior update result before Cobra
entries.stateFiles: none for help/version/completion; startup update state is consumed only on ordinary routes
entries.processBoundary: cmd/ycy owns the sole os.Exit; internal/ycycmd owns startup, signals, hidden updater, thumbnail worker, and root composition
entries.redaction: panic diagnostics pass through logging.Redact; leaf errors must already be safe; private worker streams are undecorated

entries.stdin: environment selection only when discovery is ambiguous
entries.stdout: heading plus deterministic JSON, or a target-file message when --out is used; cancellation is a successful result
entries.stderr: selection prompts/retries in interactive modes; safe root error on discovery/read/encode/write failure
entries.signals: finite command; context cancellation is represented as its existing cancellation result
entries.sideEffects: reads dotenv files; --out overwrites the resolved target after the target message is emitted
entries.stateFiles: selected dotenv files are read; no ycy state file is mutated
entries.permissions: source read and target write permissions are enforced by the filesystem
entries.redaction: dotenv values appear only in the intended JSON result; selection metadata contains filenames, not values

entries.stdin: list none; add collects alias/host/provider/protocol/secret token; remove selects then confirms
entries.stdout: safe ordered instance table/count; add/remove success or cancellation result; empty remove emits a no-op result
entries.stderr: interactive prompts and validation; read/write/automation errors as one root diagnostic
entries.exit: valid list/add/remove and cancellation 0; storage/validation/required-interaction failures 1
entries.signals: finite command; cancellation is an interaction result, not a process signal contract
entries.sideEffects: add encrypts and atomically persists one instance, silently overwriting an alias; remove mutates only after confirmation
entries.stateFiles: <home>/.ycy-cli/config.json and its lock are read/written by internal/appconfig
entries.permissions: configuration directory/file ownership and mode remain appconfig-owned
entries.redaction: list exposes only encrypted token previews; add never echoes the token; remove prompts use safe alias/host projections

entries.stdin: list/use/set/test none; add collects profile/base URL/model/API key; remove confirms
entries.stdout: safe profile list, selection/update result, provider response, or cancellation; API keys are excluded
entries.stderr: interactive prompts/validation and redacted operational diagnostics
entries.signals: finite command; interaction cancellation is a result
entries.sideEffects: add/set/remove atomically update encrypted CM configuration; use changes only the default profile; test is non-mutating
entries.stateFiles: <home>/.ycy-cli/config.json and its lock are read/written by internal/appconfig
entries.permissions: configuration directory/file ownership and mode remain appconfig-owned
entries.processBoundary: provider test uses the injected HTTP client; no child process
entries.redaction: profile projections omit decrypted keys; provider errors and response content are key-redacted

entries.stdout: one startup document containing local/network browser and MCP URLs plus baseline/target directories, then no normal stream until shutdown
entries.stderr: root startup/bind/serve diagnostics; no current Lifecycle Log
entries.exit: successful foreground shutdown 0; validation/bind/serve failure 1; SIGINT/SIGTERM are normal shutdown
entries.signals: SIGINT and SIGTERM close the foreground server and return success
entries.sideEffects: reads comparison roots and publishes an in-memory Comparison Snapshot; refresh requests mutate only service state
entries.permissions: filesystem reads and optional public bind follow host permissions
entries.processBoundary: foreground HTTP/MCP service in the ycy process; no child process
entries.redaction: startup paths/URLs are current human-readable result data; no credentials are emitted

entries.stdout: startup URLs/directories/capability facts and a stopped checkpoint on normal shutdown
entries.stderr: root startup/serve diagnostics; no current Lifecycle Log
entries.exit: successful foreground shutdown 0; validation/bind/serve failure 1; SIGINT is normal shutdown
entries.signals: SIGINT closes the foreground server and emits the existing stopped stdout checkpoint
entries.sideEffects: reads workspace and may create bounded session/task state, archives, uploads, downloads, and thumbnails
entries.stateFiles: session/task state under the configured session/state roots; temporary operation files are cleaned on completion/cancel
entries.permissions: workspace/session/archive permissions stay owned by the FS modules and platform adapters
entries.processBoundary: foreground HTTP/browser/MCP service; managed 7-Zip/thumbnail workers use their existing owned boundaries
entries.redaction: authentication credentials and task internals are not included in startup result; HTTP responses retain their schemas

entries.stdin: heat none; pulse date/author forms when flags do not resolve them; fork overwrite confirm when needed; cm selection/commit confirmation by mode
entries.stdout: complete report/acquisition/commit result, including explicit empty/cancelled/partial outcomes
entries.stderr: Rich/Plain notices, prompts, tracked phases, and root or redacted provider diagnostics
entries.exit: command-specific successful, cancellation, partial, and owned child outcomes; operational failures retain their existing code/result behavior
entries.signals: finite Git work cooperatively observes context and process cancellation; Git child groups are stopped by internal/gitprocess
entries.sideEffects: heat/pulse read Git; fork may archive/clone/remove a confirmed destination; cm may stage, commit, and push according to flags
entries.stateFiles: Git repositories and indexes are mutated only by fork/cm contracts; no ycy config state for reports
entries.permissions: repository filesystem and Git hook permissions remain unchanged
entries.processBoundary: Git subprocesses are owned by internal/gitprocess; child output is command-owned/sanitized, not terminal decoration
entries.redaction: provider credentials, token usage, raw child errors, and unsafe repository details are projected through safe result/diagnostic boundaries

entries.stdin: explicit confirmation unless --force; smart mode action and target selection
entries.stdout: success, cancellation, empty/no-valid result, and Done/partial deletion result
entries.stderr: notices/prompts in interactive modes; root diagnostics for required-interaction or planning errors
entries.exit: existing result/exit semantics, including per-path partial failures that may still exit 0
entries.signals: finite deletion observes context cancellation before mutation and has no child process
entries.sideEffects: deletes only confirmed/forced targets under explicit and smart selection rules; concurrent failures retain committed deletions
entries.stateFiles: no ycy state file; targeted filesystem descendants are the only mutation
entries.permissions: host filesystem permissions and symlink/path-kind rules are preserved
entries.redaction: path notices follow the command's safe display projection; raw errors remain diagnostics

entries.stdin: script and package-manager selection; child inherits stdin after handoff
entries.stdout: cancellation result before launch; after launch the selected child owns raw stdout
entries.stderr: selection/launch notices and root discovery errors; child owns raw stderr
entries.exit: child exit code/signal is propagated exactly; discovery/selection/start failures use ycy error semantics
entries.signals: terminal is released before child startup; child process-group signal behavior is owned by the run/process adapter
entries.sideEffects: discovers scripts/lockfiles and launches exactly the selected manager/script argv
entries.stateFiles: reads project manifests/lockfiles; does not mutate ycy state
entries.permissions: child runs with inherited cwd and host permissions
entries.processBoundary: release-before-exec handoff; ycy does not capture, decorate, or rewrite child streams
entries.redaction: parent selection summary omits unsafe internals; child output is never copied into ycy transcript/diagnostics

entries.stdin: connect selects a remembered connection only when ambiguous; server none
entries.stdout: connect cancellation result only; server normal lifecycle has no stdout
entries.stderr: line-oriented Logger Lifecycle Logs (text or stable NDJSON), plus root diagnostics on returned errors
entries.exit: normal context shutdown 0; configuration/runtime failures preserve existing logger/root behavior and codes
entries.signals: foreground client/server observe context and signal shutdown with exactly the existing cleanup ownership
entries.sideEffects: reads/writes tunnel config/state, owns control-plane sessions, and manages pinned FRP child lifecycles
entries.stateFiles: tunnel state/database/locks under the tunnel state root; credentials remain encrypted or process-local
entries.permissions: state directory, database, FRP runtime, and server data permissions remain platform-owned
entries.processBoundary: tunnelruntime owns authenticated network sessions; managed frpc/frps children are supervised and stopped by tunnel commands
entries.redaction: tokens/passwords, full credentials, and unsafe FRP details are redacted before Logger serialization; NDJSON fields remain stable

entries.stdout: Done, cancellation, warning, and operational result documents with existing exit semantics
entries.stderr: planning notices/prompts and root diagnostics; Automation rejects required planning interaction
entries.exit: existing success/cancellation/normal-failure result semantics, including nonfatal reveal failure
entries.signals: finite archive work observes context cancellation; no child process
entries.sideEffects: reads selected workspace files, writes/overwrites the selected ZIP, and optionally invokes host reveal/open
entries.stateFiles: no ycy state file; output archive is the durable artifact
entries.permissions: source traversal and output write permissions remain filesystem-owned
entries.processBoundary: host reveal uses the existing platform command boundary; archive collection/compression stays in-process
entries.redaction: paths and remote metadata use safe projections; file contents are never copied to diagnostics

entries.stdout: consumed startup transaction, already-current, scheduled, aborted, or update result documents
entries.stderr: safe root/updater diagnostics; classified abort keeps its owned result/exit behavior
entries.exit: existing updater-specific success and unusual exit codes are preserved
entries.signals: parent schedules detached updater; hidden updater owns its replacement process lifecycle
entries.sideEffects: resolves/downloads/verifies candidate, persists transaction state, and schedules replacement/rollback according to updater contracts
entries.stateFiles: updater transaction/candidate files in the target directory and startup-consumed state
entries.permissions: candidate executable/quarantine and replacement permissions remain updater-owned
entries.processBoundary: parent/hidden-updater agreement; detached updater is never decorated as a child command stream
entries.redaction: release URLs, checksums, paths, and updater errors are safe/redacted in diagnostics and result projections
